title: Construction Supervision 2026: Scope, Competence, Penalties
desc: Construction supervision under Decree 207/2026: 12 supervision duties, practicing certificates, reports, 24-hour acceptance and Decree 339/2026 fines.
summary: Construction supervision duties of the investor/supervision consultant, competence requirements, inspection and approval process, handling violations, fines and a daily checklist for supervisors.
lead: For chief supervisors and supervisors of the investor and supervision consultants: carry out all 12 supervision duties, with proper competence and records – avoiding fines and suspension of operations.
body: p

Construction works must be supervised for quality, quantities, schedule, occupational safety and environmental protection throughout construction; for individual houses of households and individuals, the law only encourages supervision (Clause 1, Article 56 of the Construction Law 2025). Supervision must be honest, objective and non-profiteering; it must check compliance with the approved design, regulations, standards, material requirements, technical specifications and the contract (Clause 2, Article 56).
h2
1. Who supervises? The investor self-performs or hires a consultant
ul

The investor may self-supervise or hire a supervision contractor; if not self-performing, it must hire a supervision consultant suited to the type and grade of the works (Art. 60, Construction Law 2025).

If the investor, an EPC contractor or a turnkey contractor performs both supervision and construction itself, it must set up a supervision unit independent of the unit directly carrying out construction (Clause 4, Article 20 of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).

Works using public investment capital or State budget funds: the supervision organization must be independent of the construction contractor and of the contractors supplying materials and equipment; it may not take part in assessing the quality of works it supervises (Clause 5, Article 20). Projects with other funds are not bound by this clause but should still ensure independence.

The selected supervision contractor must propose supervision solutions, procedures for controlling quality, quantities, schedule, safety and environment, inspection and acceptance procedures, and record management (Clause 3, Article 56).
h2
2. Competence requirements for supervisors
p

Construction supervision is a position that requires a practicing certificate of Grade I, II or III (Clause 1, Article 88 of the Construction Law 2025). Law 24/2026/QH16 amends Clauses 1 and 2 of Article 88 from 1 March 2027: the list of positions requiring a certificate drops "leading cost determination, verification and management" but retains construction supervision (Clause 4, Article 2 of Law 24/2026/QH16).
ul
Supervision certificate fields are: supervision of construction work on works; supervision of equipment installation on works (Point d, Clause 1, Article 28 of Decree 212/2026/ND-CP).

Experience by grade (Article 37): Grade I – has served as chief supervisor or lead designer of the corresponding work on 01 Grade I or higher work or 02 Grade II works; Grade II – 01 Grade II work or 02 Grade III works; Grade III – has taken part in supervision, design or construction of the corresponding work on 01 Grade III or higher work or 02 Grade IV works.
Newly issued certificates are valid for 10 years (Clause 5, Article 27).

No certificate is required when supervising finishing work such as plastering, tiling, painting, door installation and other work that does not affect load-bearing structures (Point c, Clause 3, Article 27).
p

The supervision organization must build a quality management system and a safety management system and have enough personnel on site; the structure consists of a chief supervisor and supervisors depending on scale (Clause 2, Article 20). Assigning a supervisor without suitable practicing competence is fined VND 40–60 million and may lead to suspension of supervision activities for 06–09 months (Point h, Clause 2 and Clause 4, Article 29 of Decree 339/2026/ND-CP).
h2
3. The 12 construction supervision duties under Decree 207/2026
p
Under Clause 1, Article 20 of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP:
table

dong: Check that the contractor's capacity (personnel, equipment, quality management system) matches the bid and contract
Capacity inspection minutes, personnel and equipment lists
Review and approve the items submitted by the contractor under Clause 3, Article 15 (testing plan, material control measures, construction method statement, schedule, acceptance plan)
Check the construction organization against the approved method statement and safety measures
Inspect and approve materials, components, products and equipment
Inspect and urge the contractor to build per design and schedule
Supervise safety, safety of adjacent works, and monitoring
Request the investor to adjust the design when errors or irrationalities are found
Request suspension of construction when quality or safety is not assured; coordinate incident handling
Inspect the laboratory, sampling, sample retention, and test and monitoring results used for acceptance
Accept work; inspect and confirm completed quantities; inspect and confirm as-built drawings
Acceptance minutes, quantity confirmation sheets, signed as-built drawings
Other duties under the construction contract

body: h2
4. On-site inspection, approval and acceptance process
ol
Receive the request: the contractor sends the acceptance request form after self-inspection.
Check the basis: construction drawings, technical specifications, regulations, standards, material and equipment test results and related monitoring results (Clause 2, Article 22).
Inspect on site within not more than 24 hours of receiving the request; if not agreeing, give written reasons (Clause 3, Article 22).
Prepare the minutes: work name, time, location, signatories, conclusion on acceptance or not, permission to proceed to the next work, repair requirements (Clause 4, Article 22).
Signatories: the investor's direct supervisor; the person directly in charge of techniques of the contractor (and of the subcontractor if any) (Clause 5, Article 22).
Confirm quantities by period or stage, checking against design quantities as the basis for payment; additional quantities must be approved by the investor / investment decision-maker (Article 18).
p

Stage and part-of-works acceptance: the investor and the contractor agree on timing, sequence and conditions; the chief supervisor must be among the participants (Clause 3, Article 23). Completion acceptance: the chief supervisor and the legal representative (or authorized person) of the supervision contractor sign together (Point b, Clause 6, Article 24).
h2
5. Supervision reports
p
The supervising organization or individual must prepare supervision reports for the investor and is responsible for their accuracy and honesty (Clause 3, Article 20):
ul
Periodic reports or reports by construction stage – timing set by the investor in the contract or the assignment decision;
Reports when organizing stage acceptance and completion acceptance of the package, item or works.
p

Report content follows Appendices IV and IVa of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP (the full text of the appendices is not yet in our library). Failing to prepare a supervision report, or preparing one with incomplete content, is fined VND 40–60 million (Point i, Clause 2, Article 29).
h2
6. Handling quality and safety violations
p
Rights and obligations of the supervision contractor (Article 63 of the Construction Law 2025):
ul

Require the construction contractor to build per design and contract; suspend construction when there is a risk of unsafety or construction deviates from the design, and immediately report to the investor;
Refuse acceptance when the works do not meet quality requirements or do not conform to regulations, standards or design;
Reserve its opinion on its own supervision work; refuse requests that are contrary to law;
Pay compensation if it distorts supervision results, fails to report when construction quantities deviate from the design, or fails to comply with regulations.
p
The investor must promptly handle the supervisor's proposals (Point c, Clause 2, Article 60) and has the right to replace a supervisor who does not perform properly (Point b, Clause 1, Article 60).
h2
7. Supervision-related fines (Decree 339/2026)
p
Under Article 29 of Decree 339/2026/ND-CP (violations by the investor or consulting organizations in construction supervision):
table

dong: Failing to check the construction contractor's capacity (personnel, equipment, laboratory, quality management system); failing to approve other items submitted by the contractor

Failing to approve materials; failing to supervise safety, adjacent works and monitoring; failing to approve the testing plan, method statement or schedule; failing to request suspension when an accident occurs; failing to confirm, or wrongly confirming, as-built drawings; failing to organize counter-testing or assessment as required; accepting out of sequence, with wrong participants or without minutes; having no quality management system, insufficient personnel or supervisors lacking competence; failing to prepare supervision reports; failing to inspect the laboratory
Failing to inspect and confirm completed quantities or wrongly confirming increased quantities; accepting work that does not ensure quality or conform to standards, regulations or design
Suspension of construction supervision activities for 06–09 months for violations concerning the quality management system, personnel and competence (Point h, Clause 2)

body: p

Individuals who violate are fined half the amount for organizations (Clause 4, Article 5). In addition, the investor must pay compensation if it selects an incompetent supervision consultant or wrongly accepts quantities (Point e, Clause 2, Article 60 of the Construction Law).
h2
8. Daily checklist for supervisors
ul
Start of shift: check the contractor's personnel and equipment against the plan; safety measures in hazardous areas.
Materials arriving on site: check certificates, conformity and the lot; witness sampling; prepare material acceptance minutes.
During the shift: monitor construction against drawings and method statements; record defects and request remedies in writing.
Accept work within 24 hours of receiving the request; if not approving, state reasons in writing.
Keep the diary and date-stamped site photos; update accepted quantities.
End of week/period: supervision report; review that quality records match actual dates.
On signs of an incident or accident risk: request suspension and report to the investor immediately.
p
See also: QA/QC – Quality management, Quality & acceptance files, Quick calculators.
note

This is a summary for reference and does not replace legal documents. The fines are the amounts for organizations under Decree 339/2026/ND-CP (effective from 26 August 2026); for individuals the amount is half. From 1 March 2027, Clauses 1 and 2 of Article 88 of the Construction Law 2025 are amended by Law 24/2026/QH16; construction supervision still requires a practicing certificate. Appendix II (certificate scope) of Decree 212/2026 and Appendices IV and IVa of Decree 207/2026 should be checked against the original documents.
